Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional payment platforms often exclude specific countries from their services, citing regulatory or security concerns. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, operates independently of these restrictions, allowing creators to transact freely and maintain control over their financial operations. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a more cost-effective solution, with platforms like NOWPayments charging a nominal 0.5% fee per transaction. Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With traditional ecommerce platforms, creators often sacrifice ownership and control over their digital products. This level of control and automation enables creators to focus on producing high-quality content and building strong relationships with their customers.
